k:HH.Setting.insurance.loading.Desc: Surcharge on the expected damage that makes up the premium. On average the insurer keeps this share; 0 % is actuarially fair.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.maxPersonSum.Desc: Highest basic sum of an accident, retirement or travel policy (also at most twice the market value of the pawn).
k:HH.Setting.insurance.maxPropertySum.De: Highest sum insured of a property policy.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.negotiation.Desc: Claims can be negotiated (up to three rounds). On Standard Room negotiating never costs anything.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.noticeDays.Desc: A cancellation takes effect at the first quadrum change at least this many days after you file it. Standard Room 3 days, Overbooked one quadrum, "Why?" a year.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.pensionMaxWorkHou: Pension: allowed work hours per day
Hours per day a pensioner may have set to Work in the timetable. Anything, Joy, Sleep and Meditate count as free time.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.pensionRule.Desc: Whoever draws a daily pension (Golden Years, Good Enough or Premium, age 60+) may work only a few hours per day in the timetable. Enforce: strikes cost the pension (2nd: this period's pension, 3rd: the entitlement). Warn only: letters and the alert, no penalty. Off: no rule.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.requireResearch.D: Policies unlock with the research projects SL_Insurance (Bare Minimum, Good Enough) and SL_Actuarial (Premium, Wanderlust). Off: everything is available at once.
How many times Desmond Tally (Senior Retention Specialist) talks you out of cancelling. Standard Room: one honest offer.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.salesPressure.Des: How hard Clawback Mutual sells: pre-ticked add-ons, retention offers, form errors, upsell hints. Each trick also has its own switch below.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.showStatusColumn: Insurance column in the colonist tables
Shows the insurance status of every colonist in the Assign table (only once the first policy exists).
k:HH.Setting.insurance.showStatusTab.Des: Adds an Insurance tab to the inspector of colonists (only once the first policy exists).
k:HH.Setting.insurance.trick.badge.Desc: The badge on the Premium column (and, harder, the greyed-out "Premium Plus").
k:HH.Setting.insurance.trick.formError.D: Cancellations that come back with a form error.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.trick.preTicked.D: Add-ons that are ticked for you (follows Sales pressure, always, or never).
k:HH.Setting.insurance.trick.upsell.Desc: Letters that suggest more or better cover (never within five days after a death).
k:HH.Setting.insurance.trickCap.Desc: All sales tricks together may cost at most this share of the yearly premiums; the rest is paid back as "Courtesy credit" in the yearly letter.
k:HH.Setting.insurance.waitingDays.Desc: Cover begins after this many days ("which begins after cover begins"). Damage inside the waiting period is not paid.
k:HH.Setting.kitchen.cookSounds.Desc: Every kind of cooking (chopping, simmering, grilling, baking, frying, steaming, kneading, smoking, chilling) has its own sound and little effect, finished fine dishes ring a cue and good plates get a happy reaction. Off: the vanilla pan-frying sound for everything.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.colonyFee.Desc: Extra silver per ticket that you keep (it raises the price buyers see).
k:HH.Setting.lottery.colonyInterval.Desc: A draw every this many days; the jackpot rolls over.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.colonyJackpotCap.De: The jackpot of your lottery rolls over until this amount.
Share of the pot for 4 right numbers.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.colonyOn.Desc: Run your own lottery: your guests and the simulated players of friendly settlements buy tickets, you keep what is not paid out.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.colonyPrice.Desc: Price of one ticket of your own lottery.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.colonyQuote.Desc: Share of the ticket price that goes into the pot. The rest is yours. A better share than the global draw attracts more buyers.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.colonySecondShare.D: Share of the pot for 3 right numbers.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.colonyThirdShare.De: Share of the pot for 2 right numbers.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.demandBase.Desc: Tickets per person per day at neutral conditions, the base of the demand formula.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.globalInterval.Desc: A draw every this many days.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.globalOn.Desc: The global lottery: a draw every few days, tickets bought in the bank window.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.globalPrice.Desc: Price of one ticket of the global draw.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.globalQuote.Desc: Share of the ticket sales that goes into prizes (the jackpot gets 40 % of it).
Multiplies the tickets the simulated players of all settlements buy for the global draw.
k:HH.Setting.lottery.jackpotCap.Desc: The jackpot rolls over until it reaches this amount.
k:HH.Setting.thrumbo.edgeShift.Desc: Percentage points added to the house edge of every Lucky Thrumbo game (base: slots 8 %, roulette 2.7 %, blackjack by the rules). 0 = the standard edges; negative numbers are in your favour. Follows the difficulty slider.
k:HH.Setting.thrumbo.maxBetCap.Desc: Only when the table limit is on: no stake is ever higher than this.
k:HH.Setting.thrumbo.maxBetFloor.Desc: Only when the table limit is on: even a poor colony may stake at least this much per round.
k:HH.Setting.thrumbo.maxBetShare: Lucky Thrumbo: table limit (share of net worth)
k:HH.Setting.thrumbo.maxBetShare.Desc: Only when the table limit is on: one stake may be at most this share of your net worth (account plus silver at home, minus debts), between the floor and the cap below.
k:HH.Setting.thrumbo.minBet.Desc: The smallest stake the Lucky Thrumbo accepts.
k:HH.Setting.thrumbo.tableLimit.Desc: When on, one stake is at most a share of your net worth (the three settings below). Off: you can stake everything you have.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.exposureChance: Chance a respectable guest stumbles on the back room
k:HH.Setting.underworld.exposureChance.D: Per check (about every 2 hours) while respectable guests are present and the back room was in use. Follows the difficulty slider.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.fence.buyPercent: Share of the market value the fence pays for stolen goods.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.fence.capital.De: The fence pays from its own cash box. It tops it up from the till, and surplus goes back to the till.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.fence.exposureCh: Per resold stolen item: the faction it was stolen from learns where it ended up.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.fence.goodwillHi: Before the difficulty cap of your tier.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.fence.sellPercen: Share of the market value shady buyers pay.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.feeMin.Desc: What a gang member pays for the back room.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.intervalDay: Average time between gang visits once the back room, fight pit or fence exists.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.intimidateC: Chance a gang demands protection money
Follows the difficulty slider; Standard Room and easier never forces anything on you but a dialog you can refuse.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.prisonAcces: Allows the holding cells tour (questioning of prisoners) for gang guests. Off by default; prisons are closed to every guest otherwise.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.gang.tourFee.Des: Paid by a gang member for questioning a prisoner for an hour.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.hunt.quarryCount: Animals the party brings into the hunting ground.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.hunt.quarryHours: Hours a human quarry must survive
A prisoner who survives this long or reaches the fence line is free.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.lounge.price.Des: What a guest pays in the drug lounge. Guests only take what their ideology allows.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.mode.Desc: Discover in game: a shady stranger asks if you have a back room, and only a yes opens the dark side. Always on: it is open from the start. (Off is the module switch; Cozy content intensity hides it completely.)
